rule.context_history: one actual baseline command and two observed joint positions
rule.context_support: closed per-condition coordinate minima/maxima of the four training features; no padding
rule.condition_default: complete four-start controller ranked by whole-episode quality, then action index
rule.retrieval: current command phase/contact and scaled state distance; immutable condition-filtered cases
rule.selection: Retain a supported logical expert for thirty commands; at expiry use the unchanged gain rule. Loss of its current case support terminates commitment before any new proposal.
rule.commitment_clock: start inclusive, end exclusive; commands one through thirty expire at command thirty-one
rule.support_scope: Current logical expert before shuffled mapping; shuffled associations intentionally corrupt which expert is applied.
